actual_actions.reason: Project design intent explicitly rejected treating the current V43 Prism-inspired mechanism as mandatory architecture.
All admitted V43 point-contact and zero-mate observations remain valid within their original scope and are retained as evidence about one candidate mechanism family.
Exact V43 joint/actuation source acquisition becomes conditional on V43 surviving the architecture comparison rather than being the sole next step.

conclusion: PLAN-0009 is superseded as the active investigation path because it over-bound the design search to the existing V43 Prism chain. V43 remains a legitimate candidate with useful negative and topology evidence, but PLAN-0010 now compares mechanism families against common bottle-handling obligations before any candidate-specific motion model or CAD construction is authorized.
